# AWFLWIKIDATAWORLD

> A free, open World's Knowledge Database, Works Similar to Wikidata.org Items, Discover And Connect. AEDTP WORLD AWFLUNIVERSE

Every item is a static page at https://aedtpworld.com/wikidata/Q{number}. Full sitemap: https://aedtpworld.com/wikidata/sitemap.xml
